previousContract.meaning: Retains selected action schemas and one-seat full-recall envelopes across five decision phases.

source.meaning: Frozen product source for model fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.history: A same-seat sequence can combine event, mark, sacrifice and auction decisions with pinned event-reveal transitions from one state root; shrine-pick is accepted from its own pinned fixture, and cross-root history is rejected.
scope.projectionProvenance: Observation objects are accepted only when the v8 wrapper registered the exact deeply immutable object returned by the corresponding pinned-source adapter function in this process, retaining engine and state-root identity; event-reveal inputs to later projections must be registered same-engine, same-state v8 transitions.
scope.publicTransitions: Only the sanitized event-reveal result returned by the pinned event resolver is represented as an intervening public transition.
scope.chronology: Rounds cannot move backward; within a round, supported decisions follow event, reveal, mark, sacrifice, auction and shrine-pick order and must advance to a later tracked state revision. Before history or a current key advances, the prior event must have its matching reveal and prior mark, sacrifice or shrine-pick actions must have been committed. Recorded later-phase loci, including auction records across separate histories, block opening or settling an earlier event phase; the same state-round event phase cannot reopen at a later revision.
scope.freshness: A private per-state revision invalidates projections after v8-wrapped event resolution, mark commitment, sacrifice commitment, shrine resolution start or shrine-pick commitment; commits also reject decision loci whose revision is no longer current. Event decisions are bound to their creation state, round and revision; observation, commitment and settlement reject stale decisions. The same state-round event phase cannot reopen at a later revision, and opening or settling it after a later phase action is rejected. Mutations outside these wrappers and unmodeled automatic transitions are not revision-tracked.
scope.actionStateBinding: Each state/phase/round/viewer/revision decision locus binds to one canonical action across histories and decision objects; late appends must match an already committed choice even when they use another event decision object. Conflicts, stale commits and repeated commits at one locus are rejected. Repeated sacrifice requires a new decision/observation/history record at the new revision. History progression requires prior supported mark, sacrifice and shrine-pick actions to be committed. Auction action/state reconciliation is not covered.
scope.markTiming: Paired event-night mark-timing diagnostic is complete for its declared deterministic AI fixture; it does not establish human fairness or general win-rate equivalence.
deferred: Every public and automatic transition other than the selected event reveal
Complete chance support and conditional branch probabilities through combat, settlement, market and event scheduling
Cross-night state restoration and canonicalization with matching gameplay/UI RNG streams, history and private destiny
Terminal utility, policy enumeration and feasible solver scope
Independent full-game information-set and solver review

proves: The v8 engine wrapper verifies the frozen product-source pin before loading its combined adapter API.
All five accepted phase observations were returned by their pinned adapter projection calls and are associated with private in-process provenance.
A schema-shaped frozen copy without that provenance is rejected.
An event transition is rejected unless the seat's recorded sealed choice matches the pinned resolver's public reveal.

Decision-locus action binding rejects conflicting histories even when distinct decision objects represent the same state, phase, round, seat and revision; a late event record is also compared with the committed state-locus choice.

An event decision is bound to its creation state, round and revision; stale settlement, later-phase-first event creation (including an auction action recorded in another history) and event reopening at a later revision are rejected.
Later projections reject caller-shaped reveal payloads and repeated same-event transition inputs.

A pinned sanitized event reveal can be appended between decisions, is required before the history advances beyond that event, affects the information-set key, and cannot be duplicated or replaced by a copied object.
History and current projections from different state roots are rejected even when they share the same engine instance.

Stale projections and commits are rejected after event resolution, mark or sacrifice commitment, shrine resolution start, and shrine-pick commitment through supported v8 wrappers; current observations cannot regress behind recorded history.

Single-seat, supported within-round phase order, unique single-use phase and nondecreasing-round guards apply to supported sequence records; event settlement and shrine resolution start are each single-use per state and round, and each recorded action binding is consumed at most once.
doesNotProve: Complete game decision or transition coverage
Exhaustive public-transition support, chance probabilities or full information-set equivalence
Cross-night restoration, canonicalization, payoff completeness or solver correctness

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: complete chance and cross-night restore contract
requirements: Enumerate all random branches with conditional probabilities through automatic battle, settlement and cross-night market/event scheduling.
Restore canonical cross-night snapshots with matching gameplay and UI RNG streams, public history and private destiny state.
Represent every sanitized public and automatic transition between decisions.
Define terminal utility and a feasible policy/solver scope before any pass claim.
Retain an independent review of the complete model against the frozen product source.

gate.blockingReason: V8 binds selected observations to pinned in-process projections and records only event reveal transitions. Complete chance, remaining public transitions, cross-night restore, canonicalization, terminal payoff, policy enumeration and independent solver review remain incomplete.
